resources.string: Could not connect to the computer. Check the Wi-Fi network.
Bluetooth permission missing. Accept it and try again.
Could not connect by Bluetooth. Check that the phone and the computer
are paired and that the Kikoia is open on the computer.
The computer has no active code. Generate a new code on the computer.
Wrong or expired code. Generate a new code on the computer.
This phone is no longer paired with the computer. Enter the code.
The computer rejected a message. Pair again.
This phone is no longer paired with the computer. Enter the code shown on the computer.
For a more comfortable keyboard, turn the device to landscape.
This app turns this device into a keyboard for the computer.
Everything you type is processed on the computer (suggestions, voice, AI and apps).
To find the computer on the Wi-Fi network, the «Nearby devices» permission is needed.
Tip: turn the device sideways for a more comfortable keyboard.
No computer found. Check that the Kikoia is open on the computer,
that both are on the same Wi-Fi network and that Windows allows the connection (Firewall).
No paired computer. Pair the phone with the computer in the Android Bluetooth settings
On the computer, open the Kikoia, click the gear and «Phone».
Type here the 6-digit code shown on the screen.
You may need additional settings, such as configuring port forwarding on your router.
A new version of Kikoia is available: %1$s
